Projects

Rakathon 2026 · AI in healthcare

Pill Scan

Pill Scan uses artificial intelligence to turn an ordinary photo of a medicine box or a handwritten note into a clear, reliable list of the medicines a patient takes — one the patient can easily share with their doctor.

ReactAIHealthcare
The challenge

People — especially oncology patients — often combine many medicines from different specialists. At the doctor’s office they can’t recall exact names, dosages or strengths. Writing everything down by hand takes precious time, is error-prone and makes it easy to miss interactions or duplicate active substances.

Our solution

A mobile web app that instantly turns a photo into structured data. The doctor gets a clear table with optional modules (interaction and duplicate checks, links to oncology treatment). Everything the AI pre-fills stays fully under the doctor’s control and can be edited at any time.

How it works

01

Entering medication

AI scan

The patient photographs a medicine box or a handwritten note. The built-in AI recognises the name, strength, dosage and active substance.

02

Entering medication

Manual entry with validation

No box at hand? The medicine can be typed in. The app checks it against the official medicine database and flags typos or mistakes.

03

Managing & checking

Review and save

The patient checks the recognised details, edits them if needed and saves them to a personal library.

04

Managing & checking

Personal medicine library

One clear hub of all medicines with search, sorting and filtering by name, dosage and other parameters.

05

Sharing with the doctor

Timed QR code / PIN export

The patient picks which medicines to share and generates a unique QR code with a PIN valid for 1 minute. The doctor scans it or enters the PIN and gets instant access.

🔒

Security & privacy first

Anonymous profile

All you need is a nickname — no name, birth number or date of birth.

Transfer under control

Data is handed over in person, on request, and only through a time-limited code.

Zero server footprint

When the session ends, shared data is deleted from the servers immediately and stays only on the patient’s device.

Built completely from scratch on publicly available medicine databases and image libraries.

AT&T Hackathon 2025 · Educational game

Linearium

An interactive educational platform that makes teaching mathematical functions in schools more engaging. It began as a prototype at the 2025 hackathon, where its concept and execution caught the attention of the creative director of the game studio Bohemia Interactive.

Development carried on after the event: the team grew with more developers and designers and, guided by a mentor from the game-dev industry, moved toward real use in school lessons. The goal is to make abstract maths accessible through modern game mechanics, real-time visualisation and interactive tasks. (Try the sliders — that’s the idea in miniature.)
